name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the case of Maria Shahbaz, a 13-year-old Christian girl from Lahore who was abducted, forced to convert and married, and whose conversion and marriage a Pakistani court upheld in March 2026. The Parliament condemns this and similar cases, and asks Pakistan to protect these girls, investigate properly, punish those responsible, and enforce a minimum marriage age of 18.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Pakistan to act on child marriage, forced conversion and protection of girls.
- **Who it affects:** Girls from religious minorities in Pakistan, especially Maria Shahbaz, and Pakistani courts and authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council, Commission, foreign policy chief and Pakistan's government and parliament.
